description: This plot illustrates the perplexity evaluation across different evaluation context lengths for three different retaining ratios, denoted by gamma ($\gamma$). The x-axis is labeled "Evaluation Context Length" and uses a discrete scale with the values 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K spaced evenly along the axis. The y-axis is labeled "PPL" and features a linear scale ranging from 7.7 to 8.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three solid lines, all utilizing circle markers. The blue line, representing $\gamma=0.25$, begins at a value of approximately 8.19 at 2K, experiences a sharp decline to 7.83 at 4K, rises slightly to 7.84 at 8K, drops to 7.78 at 16K, increases to 7.79 at 32K, and ends at 7.78 at 64K. The orange line, representing $\gamma=0.5$, starts at 8.20 at 2K, declines sharply to 7.84 at 4K, continues to drop to 7.74 at 8K, remains steady at 7.74 at 16K, and decreases slightly to end at a flat 7.73 across 32K and 64K. The green line, representing $\gamma=0.75$, starts at 8.20 at 2K, drops sharply to 7.84 at 4K, decreases to 7.75 at 8K, declines slightly to 7.73 at 16K, and finishes with a steady trend at 7.72 across the 32K and 64K marks.
